LUNGE.gloss: the act of moving forward suddenly
LUNGE.definition: The act of moving forward suddenly.

PLUG.gloss: fill or close tightly with or as if with a plug
PLUG.definition: Fill or close tightly with or as if with a plug.

LUNG.gloss: either of two saclike respiratory organs in the chest of vertebrates
LUNG.definition: Either of two saclike respiratory organs in the chest of vertebrates; serves to remove carbon dioxide and provide oxygen to the blood.

GLEN.definition: A narrow secluded valley (in the mountains).

GUN.gloss: a weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity
GUN.definition: A weapon that discharges a missile at high velocity (especially from a metal tube or barrel).

LEG.definition: A human limb; commonly used to refer to a whole limb but technically only the part of the limb between the knee and ankle.

PEN.gloss: a writing implement with a point from which ink flows
PEN.definition: A writing implement with a point from which ink flows.

GEN.example: Give me the gen on your new line of computers.

GEL.gloss: a colloid in a more solid form than a sol
GEL.definition: A colloid in a more solid form than a sol.

GLUE.gloss: join or attach with or as if with glue
GLUE.definition: Join or attach with or as if with glue.
GLUE.example: Paste the sign on the wall.

GULP.gloss: to swallow hurriedly or greedily or in one draught
GULP.definition: To swallow hurriedly or greedily or in one draught.
GULP.example: The men gulped down their beers.
